exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy-moderate pace. Stay light on feet and relaxed through shoulders.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Controlled depth, knees track over toes, brace lightly.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Stop 2 reps before form breaks. Keep ribs down and body straight.

exercises.name: Backpack Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use a loaded backpack or any household weight. Full foot on floor, smooth tempo.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Pull elbow toward hip. Pause briefly at the top.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Soft knees, hinge at hips, keep back flat. Use moderate load.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Stay tall and controlled. Use bodyweight or hold the backpack if easy.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold a small load if available. Move under control and avoid yanking neck.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension Isometric
exercises.notes: Use your hand for light resistance. Gentle pressure only, no pain.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: Work at RPE 7. Crisp hands, footwork, and breathing control.

exercises.name: Jump Rope

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Controlled depth, knees track over toes, brace lightly.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Add 1 set from last week. Stop 1–2 reps before failure.

exercises.name: Backpack Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Add load if all week 1 reps felt comfortable. Smooth lowering.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Drive elbow back and keep torso stable.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Slight pause at stretch. Keep tension in hamstrings.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Add load only if balance and knee tracking stay clean.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Increase reps before increasing load.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension Isometric
exercises.notes: Gentle pressure only. Keep posture tall.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: Work at RPE 7–8. Maintain speed and technique, do not brawl the air.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy-moderate pace. Stay relaxed and rhythmic.

exercises.name: Pogo Jumps
exercises.notes: Quick ground contact, stiff ankles, low amplitude.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: If too easy, elevate feet slightly. Keep quality high.

exercises.name: Backpack Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Aim for a small load increase. Stay upright and controlled.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Pause 1 second at top. Do not twist torso.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Add load if available. Hinge cleanly and keep lats tight.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a low support. If unstable, stay with regular split squat.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Use a slightly heavier load if form stays solid.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension Isometric
exercises.notes: Steady pressure, no jerking.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: RPE 8. Emphasize clean combinations and footwork recovery between bursts.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Deload week. Keep it smooth and easy.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Easy warm-up reps, no fatigue.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 3 reps in reserve. Focus on perfect form.

exercises.name: Backpack Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use lighter load than week 3. Controlled tempo.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Smooth pull, brief pause, easy effort.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Lighter load. Clean hinge pattern only.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Bodyweight only if needed. Keep it easy.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Moderate effort, smooth reps.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension Isometric
exercises.notes: Light pressure only.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: RPE 6–7. Stay sharp, not exhausted.
